Samayas.Tools.ProjectsNugetUpdater - Updates NuGet packages in a .NET solution

Usage:
  Projects-Nuget-Updater <solution-directory> [options]
  Projects-Nuget-Updater setup-pat [--source=<name>] [--token=<pat>]

Commands:
  <solution-directory>    Path to the .NET solution directory (default command)
  setup-pat               Configure Personal Access Token for NuGet sources

Arguments:
  <solution-directory>    Required. Path to the .NET solution directory

Options:
  --usegit=<bool>                     | /usegit:<bool>                         Use git operations (default: true)
  --prebuild=<bool>                   | /prebuild:<bool>                       Run build before updates (default: true)
  --pretest=<bool>                    | /pretest:<bool>                        Run tests before updates (default: true)
  --postbuild=<bool>                  | /postbuild:<bool>                      Run build after updates (default: true)
  --posttest=<bool>                   | /posttest:<bool>                       Run tests after updates (default: true)
  --gitcommit=<bool>                  | /gitcommit:<bool>                      Commit changes to git (default: true)
  --gitpush=<bool>                    | /gitpush:<bool>                        Push changes to remote (default: true)
  --gitbranchname=<name>              | /gitbranchname:<name>                  Git branch name (default: feature/update-packages)
  --gitbranchcreate=<bool>            | /gitbranchcreate:<bool>                Create new git branch (default: true)
  --buildconfiguration=<config>       | /buildconfiguration:<config>           Build configuration (default: Release)
  --nugetconfigfile=<file>            | /nugetconfigfile:<file>                NuGet config file name (default: nuget.config)
  --filteronprojectfiles=<pattern>    | /filteronprojectfiles:<pattern>        Filter projects (wildcard or semicolon list)
  --excludeprojectfiles=<list>        | /excludeprojectfiles:<list>            Exclude projects (semicolon-separated list)
  --excludepackagesforupdate=<string> | /excludepackagesforupdate:<string>     Exclude packages from update (semicolon-separated list)
  --includeprerelease=<bool>          | /includeprerelease:<bool>              Include pre-release versions when selecting latest (default false)

PAT Setup Options:
  --source=<name>                     | /source:<name>                         Source name for PAT configuration
  --token=<pat>                       | /token:<pat>                           Personal Access Token

Boolean values: true/false, 1/0, yes/no

Examples:
  Update NuGet packages:
    ProjectsNugetUpdater C:\Projects\MySolution
    ProjectsNugetUpdater C:\Projects\MySolution --usegit=false
    ProjectsNugetUpdater C:\Projects\MySolution --prebuild=false --pretest=false
    ProjectsNugetUpdater C:\Projects\MySolution --gitbranchname=feature/update-deps
    ProjectsNugetUpdater C:\Projects\MySolution --buildconfiguration=Debug
    ProjectsNugetUpdater C:\Projects\MySolution --excludedpackagesforupdate="Newtonsoft.Json;System.Text.Json"

  Setup PAT:
    Projects-Nuget-Updater setup-pat
    Projects-Nuget-Updater setup-pat --source="Azure DevOps" --token=abc123...
    Projects-Nuget-Updater setup-pat /source:"Azure DevOps" /token:abc123...

Notes:
  - If git operations are enabled, the directory must be a git repository
  - PAT setup can be run interactively or with command-line parameters
  - Use setup-pat to configure authentication for private NuGet feeds
